description: Moves the task out one level, right after its summary (Shift+Tab in MS Project); the tasks that followed it on the same level become its subtasks. A summary left without subtasks becomes a normal task again with the dates it had. Changes the outline immediately, without preview. Requires write permission.

task.description: task: key (Cronos-12), uuid, 'wbs:1.2', exact name, or the ref of an earlier add_task in the same call

name: planitude_outdent_task
title: Outdent task
